race.comment: Intriguing race this with TORO STRIKE (4) and HEADHUNTER (11) facing back off after the former overturned the result with a protest. TORO STRIKE was finishing better and from the much kinder draw with Thompson sticking he can repeat the dose. HEADHUNTER was given an absolute peach from JGC last time and looked to have finally converted on a string of strong performance, but it wasn't to be. Drawn alongside his main rival makes it an exciting rematch. GIAPPONESE (6) drops back to the mile off 24 days and is in good touch. Gets in well with Pozman's 2kg claim and deserves respect. DON'TCHA THINK (8) has been around the mark, including a third behind the top pair last time who he meets with  a handy little pull at the weights. Gets his chance to turn the tables.
